format: Workflow is canonical JSON, a YAML1.2 subset; parsed with built-in JSON to avoid adding a YAML parser dependency
audit: Strict nonzero on any reported vulnerability or acquisition/parse failure; no allowlist, approved exception or silent continue-on-error
production: No deploy/upload/version activation, Cloudflare credentials, Sites publication, production HTTP test or manual collection
github: Workflow remains local until explicit push approval; publication may start verification CI; merge and repository settings need separate approval
limitations: Local equivalents are not a GitHub-hosted Linux run
Browser navigation/hydration smoke is a separate manual/CUA gate; HTTP tests do not prove it
Pattern secret check is defense-in-depth, not proof the complete history is secret-free
Reachability inventory does not waive any dependency audit result
